payload.author: claude
payload.body: Wire-parity fix (efc1840): object Delta fan-out + Snapshot packing now strip the record id before pack_object_record, fixing silent drops for schema object types without a declared id field (e.g. productTestSchema User). Caught by the FR-250 conformance suite. The earlier funnel_integration test used note_schema which DOES declare an id field, so it masked the bug; the conformance suite uses the real productTestSchema and exposed it.
